about: Target site contract enforced by kb/validate_site.py. Edit values here, never the validator. Numbers marked (tune) are placeholders: run the validator once on real output and adjust.

R02_duplicate_ids.what: no duplicate element id on a page

R03_broken_link.what: every internal link resolves to a file

R04_broken_anchor.what: every #anchor resolves to an id on the target

R05_no_breadcrumb.what: every page except home has a breadcrumb

R06_tab_order.what: tab bar equals tabs.order, in order, on every page

R07_rail_repeats_tab.what: left rail never repeats a tab-bar destination

R08_citation_linked.what: a page citation (p.47) is never inside a link

R09_link_in_quote.what: no link inside the quotation itself (speaker attribution after it is fine)

R10_empty_link_text.what: link text is more than punctuation or an arrow

R11_duplicate_link.what: same target linked twice in one paragraph or list item

R12_page_too_big.what: visible words within max_words for the page type

R13_evidence_on_index.what: directory-type pages hold no scene blocks

R14_unlabelled_marker.what: every row label is in the MARKERS table

R15_entity_link_text.what: link text to an entity page is a name that entity uses

R16_redirect_target.what: a redirect page points at a file that exists

R17_label_mismatch.what: a link labelled with a section name goes to that section

R18_wording.what: no pipeline vocabulary (ledger, dossier, database, raw volume ids) on any page

R19_second_person.what: no second person in published prose; quoted speech is exempt (some ledger rows quote speech without quote marks)
